name: mod-firewall
description: A firewall for Claude Code mods: watches what every other mod does (network, processes, secret files, env vars) and asks, blocks or logs

mode.title: Mod firewall: mode
mode.description: ask: sensitive calls by a mod (network, processes, secret files, secret env vars, writes outside the project) open a dialog. strict: they are blocked unless you trust the mod. audit: allow everything and only log.

trusted.title: Mod firewall: trusted mods
trusted.description: Comma-separated mod names that may make sensitive calls without asking (critical ones, like sending a secret, still ask). Mods you trust from the dialog are remembered separately.

refuseRiskyAtLoad.title: Mod firewall: refuse risky mods at load
refuseRiskyAtLoad.description: Refuse to load an untrusted mod that uses the network together with processes, files, env vars or the transcript. Only mods that load after the firewall can be refused.
